points.title: 童年与教育
points.description: 比尔·盖茨1955年出生于西雅图的一个富裕家庭，父亲是著名律师，母亲是银行高管。他自幼展现出对计算机的浓厚兴趣，13岁时就读于私立学校湖滨中学(Lakeside School)，在那里首次接触到计算机，并开始编程。他与保罗·艾伦成为好友，共同开发了第一个商业程序——一个计算班级课表的系统。这段经历奠定了他对计算机技术的热情和早期编程能力。
points.descriptionEn: Bill Gates was born in 1955 in Seattle to a wealthy family; his father was a prominent lawyer and his mother a bank executive. From an early age, he showed a keen interest in computers. At age 13, while attending Lakeside School, he was first exposed to computers and began programming. He formed a close friendship with Paul Allen, with whom he developed his first commercial program—a class scheduling system. This experience laid the foundation for his passion for computer technology and early programming skills.

points.title: 哈佛岁月
points.description: 盖茨进入哈佛大学学习，但并未专注于法律专业，而是对计算机科学产生了浓厚兴趣。在哈佛期间，他开发了第一个微型计算机版本的BASIC编程语言，为Altair 8800计算机准备。1975年，当他得知Altair计算机问世时，与保罗·艾伦联系并声称已经为其开发了BASIC解释器。实际上他们尚未编写代码，但在得到机会后，仅用几周时间就完成了开发。这一事件成为微软公司诞生的关键契机。
points.descriptionEn: Gates attended Harvard University but did not focus on his law major, instead developing a strong interest in computer science. During his time at Harvard, he developed a version of the BASIC programming language for microcomputers, preparing it for the Altair 8800. In 1975, when he learned about the Altair's release, he contacted Paul Allen and claimed they had already developed a BASIC interpreter for it. In reality, they hadn't written the code yet, but after getting the opportunity, they completed the development in just a few weeks. This event became the key catalyst for the birth of Microsoft.

points.title: 微软初创
points.description: 1975年，盖茨与保罗·艾伦正式创立微软公司(Microsoft)，最初总部设在新墨西哥州的阿尔伯克基。公司最初专注于为各种计算机系统开发软件，尤其是BASIC解释器。1979年，公司迁往华盛顿州的贝尔维尤。在早期发展中，盖茨与IBM达成协议，为IBM个人电脑开发操作系统，这一决定奠定了微软在个人电脑软件领域的统治地位。他购买了QDOS操作系统并将其改造为MS-DOS，成为IBM PC的预装系统，这一决策使微软获得了巨大成功。
points.descriptionEn: In 1975, Gates and Paul Allen formally founded Microsoft, with its initial headquarters in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company initially focused on developing software for various computer systems, particularly BASIC interpreters. In 1979, the company moved to Bellevue, Washington. During its early development, Gates reached an agreement with IBM to develop an operating system for their personal computers, a decision that established Microsoft's dominance in the personal computer software industry. He acquired QDOS and transformed it into MS-DOS, which became the pre-installed system for IBM PCs, a decision that brought Microsoft tremendous success.

points.title: Windows时代
points.description: 1980年，微软总部迁至华盛顿州的雷德蒙德，并在此发展成为全球最大的软件公司。1985年，微软推出Windows 1.0操作系统，开创了图形用户界面的新时代。1990年发布的Windows 3.0和1995年发布的Windows 95取得了巨大成功，使微软成为全球最具价值的科技公司之一。盖茨以其远见卓识和商业头脑领导微软，实施严格的知识产权保护策略，通过捆绑销售和排他性协议巩固市场地位。这一时期，微软的市值从1986年上市时的几亿美元增长到1999年的超过6000亿美元。
points.descriptionEn: In 1980, Microsoft moved its headquarters to Redmond, Washington, where it grew into the world's largest software company. In 1985, Microsoft released Windows 1.0,开创ing a new era of graphical user interfaces. Windows 3.0 in 1990 and Windows 95 in 1995 achieved tremendous success, making Microsoft one of the world's most valuable technology companies. Gates led Microsoft with his vision and business acumen, implementing strict intellectual property protection strategies and consolidating market position through bundling and exclusive agreements. During this period, Microsoft's market value grew from several billion dollars at its 1986 IPO to over $600 billion by 1999.

points.title: 互联网转型
points.description: 1995年，盖茨发布《互联网浪潮》备忘录，认识到互联网对软件行业的革命性影响，带领微软向互联网转型。公司开发了Internet Explorer浏览器与Netscape竞争，并推出Windows 98整合互联网功能。2000年，盖茨辞去CEO职务，但仍担任董事长和首席软件架构师。在此期间，微软面临反垄断调查，被指控利用Windows垄断地位打压竞争对手。2008年，盖茨逐步退出微软日常管理，将更多精力转向慈善事业。这一时期，微软从单纯的软件公司向多元化科技企业转型，但仍面临互联网时代的挑战。
points.descriptionEn: In 1995, Gates released the 'Internet Tidal Wave' memo, recognizing the revolutionary impact of the internet on the software industry and leading Microsoft's transformation toward the internet. The company developed Internet Explorer to compete with Netscape and released Windows 98 with integrated internet functionality. In 2000, Gates stepped down as CEO but remained as chairman and chief software architect. During this period, Microsoft faced antitrust investigations for allegedly using its Windows monopoly to suppress competition. In 2008, Gates gradually stepped away from Microsoft's daily management, focusing more on philanthropy. During this time, Microsoft transformed from a pure software company to a diversified technology enterprise but still faced challenges in the internet era.

points.title: 慈善事业
points.description: 2008年，盖茨将更多精力投入到慈善事业，通过比尔及梅琳达·盖茨基金会(Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation)开展全球健康和发展项目。该基金会成为全球最大的私人慈善基金会之一，致力于消除疟疾、艾滋病等疾病，改善全球卫生条件，推动教育发展。盖茨还发起'突破能源联盟'应对气候变化，并参与'核创新联盟'推动先进核能技术发展。2010年，他与沃伦·巴菲特共同发起'捐赠誓言'，鼓励亿万富翁将至少一半财富用于慈善。盖茨通过'盖茨笔记'分享阅读和思考，继续发挥其影响力。这一阶段，他从科技领袖转型为全球慈善领袖，致力于解决人类面临的重大挑战。
points.descriptionEn: In 2008, Gates shifted his focus to philanthropy, launching global health and development initiatives through the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. The foundation became one of the world's largest private philanthropic organizations, dedicated to eradicating diseases like malaria and AIDS, improving global health conditions, and advancing education. Gates also launched the Breakthrough Energy Alliance to address climate change and participated in the Nuclear Innovation Alliance to promote advanced nuclear energy technologies. In 2010, he co-founded 'The Giving Pledge' with Warren Buffett, encouraging billionaires to donate at least half of their wealth to charity. Through his 'Gates Notes,' he continues to share his reading and thoughts, maintaining his influence. In this phase, he transitioned from a tech leader to a global philanthropic leader, committed to addressing major human challenges.

supporter.zh: 比尔·盖茨被视为科技革命的关键推动者和商业创新的典范。他通过微软公司普及了个人计算机，使计算技术走进千家万户，改变了人类工作和生活方式。他的远见卓识和商业头脑不仅创造了巨大的经济价值，也推动了整个信息产业的发展。作为慈善家，他通过盖茨基金会解决了全球范围内的健康和发展问题，展现了财富的社会责任。盖茨代表了创新、远见和回馈社会的企业家精神，是现代科技领袖的标杆。
supporter.en: Bill Gates is regarded as a key driver of the technological revolution and a model of business innovation. Through Microsoft, he popularized personal computers, bringing computing technology into homes worldwide and transforming how people work and live. His vision and business acumen not only created enormous economic value but also advanced the entire information technology industry. As a philanthropist, he has addressed global health and development issues through the Gates Foundation, demonstrating social responsibility for wealth. Gates represents the entrepreneurial spirit of innovation, vision, and giving back, setting a standard for modern tech leaders.

critic.zh: 批评者认为盖茨的商业手段存在争议，微软在其领导下被指控垄断市场、打压竞争对手。他的'拥抱、扩展再消灭'策略被批评为不公平竞争手段。盖茨对知识产权的强硬态度有时被视为阻碍技术创新。在个人层面，他被批评为工作狂，对员工要求苛刻，早期微软的企业文化被描述为残酷和缺乏人文关怀。此外，他的财富积累和全球影响力也引发了关于财富集中和权力过大的担忧。批评者认为，尽管他后来投身慈善，但商业生涯中的某些决策和做法留下了负面影响。
critic.en: Critics argue that Gates' business practices were controversial, with Microsoft accused of monopolizing markets and suppressing competitors under his leadership. His 'embrace, extend, and extinguish' strategy was criticized as an unfair competitive tactic. Gates' tough stance on intellectual property was sometimes seen as hindering technological innovation. On a personal level, he was criticized as a workaholic who demanded extreme dedication from employees, with early Microsoft's culture described as ruthless and lacking human关怀. Additionally, his wealth accumulation and global influence raised concerns about wealth concentration and excessive power. Critics argue that despite his later philanthropy, certain decisions and practices during his business career left negative impacts.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，盖茨被视为一个复杂而多面的历史人物。他既是数字时代的先驱，也是商业竞争的象征。他的故事体现了美国梦的某些方面——通过创新和商业头脑取得巨大成功。同时，他的经历也反映了科技行业的发展轨迹和伴随的伦理挑战。盖茨的形象从早期的'技术极客'到后来的'商业巨头'，再到如今的'慈善家'，展现了个人身份的多元转变。在流行文化中，他既是科技创新的代表，也是财富与权力的象征，其形象不断被重新诠释和讨论。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Gates is viewed as a complex and multifaceted historical figure. He is both a pioneer of the digital age and a symbol of business competition. His story embodies certain aspects of the American dream—achieving tremendous success through innovation and business acumen. Simultaneously, his experience reflects the development trajectory of the tech industry and its accompanying ethical challenges. Gates' image has evolved from the early 'tech geek' to the 'business tycoon' and now the 'philanthropist,' demonstrating the multifaceted transformation of personal identity. In popular culture, he represents both technological innovation and the symbolism of wealth and power, with his image constantly being reinterpreted and discussed.

self.zh: 我们总是高估了两年内能实现的变化，而低估了十年内能实现的变化。
self.en: We always overestimate the change that will occur in the next two years and underestimate the change that will occur in the next ten.
